question: What documentation does Sentry support ask for after a sponsorship application from an open source project, and does the application need a signed-in Sentry organization? Both are shown only after a sign-up and an application.
why: The help article says support reviews the application and names the documentation required, and the application form names the organization to sponsor. A research agent does not create an account or apply (AGENTS.md section 2 rule 13), so the identity_cost detail of dev-services/sentry-open-source says unverified: behind a sign-up. This is a step for the open issue labelled rq:operator.
